## 7deedd72e091

**Reproduced shortcut defect: reflection is not distinguished from rotation.**
The intended rule compares object masks up to rotation only, but the rival
"rotation or reflection" fits all three canonical pairs. On generator SHA-256
`e2512216f375bcf5ed24db90b548def0aaee76656e0087206576dd9e2cc0a705`
(rule hash `8202ef2f7a10`), a deterministic search covered each difficulty band,
500 seeds, sample indices 0..7, and every consecutive 3-demo + 1-query start
0..4. It found 481 ambiguous lessons out of 7,500:

- easy: 175/2,500 lessons; 309/4,000 individual inputs disagreed;
- medium: 65/2,500; 111/4,000;
- hard: 241/2,500; 721/4,000.

Exact generator-domain witness: easy, seed `730000`, sample index `4`, no
overrides; `self_check` returned `[]`. The supported Racket apply produced a
3×3 X mask, while the dihedral rival produced a full 3×3 block. The complete
input, hashes, actual Racket output, rival output, command, and search policy are
in `checks/audit/7deedd72e091/counterexample.json`; raw apply evidence is
`checks/audit/7deedd72e091/racket.json`.

This audit did not modify the target. Recommended repair: ensure every lesson
contains a chiral/reflection distinction, and declare the dihedral rival so the
semantic gate/census can retain the witness.
